row: Duvall Veterinary Hospital is a small animal veterinary hospital located in the beautiful Snoqualmie Valley, 25 miles northeast of Seattle, Washington. We have a complete diagnostic suite, provide thorough preventive care for cats and dogs, offer routine and non-routine surgical services, have a therapeutic laser, and offer a wide range of dental services. At Duvall Veterinary Hospital, Your Pets Are Family!
